scope: Cross-preview concave-control comparison of native grouped segment order with native point-vector order.
method: Traverse face-group records in observed order, take endpoint A then B, deduplicate exact coordinates globally, and filter the resulting sequence to each face. Compare with that face point list after its three source corners.
limitations: Cross-preview capture on one scene; address values are not used for matching.
Exact coordinate deduplication models only this control; native point-search tolerance and identity behavior require separate handling.
Native record traversal order and original vertex allocation order remain unresolved.
No production change or GUI/MCP parity claim.
